The function does not match its contract.

The docstring says the total may be *at or under* the ceiling, and the contract repeats that a total landing exactly on the ceiling is permitted. The code uses a strict `<`, so a spend that lands exactly on the ceiling is rejected. The comparison should be `<=`.

This is an off-by-one at the boundary. It will not show up in ordinary use and will fire precisely when a run is sized to consume its allowance exactly.

Separately, and much less important: no type hints, and the name could be clearer. Neither of those would ship a wrong answer.
